admission.justification: Weighed shared warm Streamable HTTP and full typed outputSchemas against per-seat stdio without placeholder DictOutput schemas, constraining future transport and schema changes until measured triggers are met.

alternatives.option: Keep per-agent stdio MCP transport with explicit structured_output=False for generic dict tools (omitting placeholder DictOutput outputSchemas and duplicate structuredContent while keeping structured_output for typed BaseModel tools) and preserve the per-server write lock without auto-promoting mutating tools.
alternatives.reason: Eliminates listing schema bloat and 50% wire duplication immediately with zero transport migration risk, preserves per-seat process isolation and fail-closed read_only_hint semantics, and leaves typed BaseModel tools intact (D1078, D1079).

alternatives.option: Move local role agents onto a shared warm Streamable HTTP MCP server with per-seat routing (D1006).
alternatives.reason: Requires per-seat authentication/binding isolation, lifecycle supervision, and multi-harness Streamable HTTP support not yet uniformly available across local CLI harnesses; Wave 1a compact projections and schema savings deliver immediate context reductions without transport risk.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Measured cold-start latency or memory footprint across concurrent role seats in scripts/measure-ar-server-start.py breaches budget after Wave 1 savings, AND target harnesses support local Streamable HTTP with verified per-seat binding isolation.

alternatives.option: Author and advertise full typed Pydantic outputSchemas on all 44 public tools instead of dropping placeholder DictOutput schemas (D1079).
alternatives.reason: Full outputSchemas add thousands of listing tokens across every tools/list response while current harnesses do not enforce client-side outputSchema validation on text-JSON tool replies.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Primary harnesses demonstrably consume outputSchema for client-side routing or typed decoding AND the per-role listing token budget accommodates full schemas without trimming tool descriptions.

consequences: All 44 generic dict public tools advertise no outputSchema and emit compact single-line UTF-8 JSON TextContent with structuredContent=None.
Mutating tools (including context_packet and knowledge_diff) remain non-read-only and are never auto-promoted under the write lock.
Wave 2 Streamable HTTP and full outputSchemas stay deferred until their concrete triggers fire.
context: After moving to MCP SDK 2.3.0, all 44 public tools return generic dict[str, Any]/dict[str, object] payloads validated internally by Pydantic response models and run over per-seat stdio processes. Council #6 (D1078) and developer approval (D1079) weighed dropping placeholder DictOutput outputSchemas and duplicate structuredContent immediately versus introducing shared warm Streamable HTTP transport (D1006) or full typed outputSchemas.
decider: Developer (D1006, D1078 Council #6 with Peer Architect 6697d147, D1079)
